descriptions:
Global BABIES (Babies’ Activities & Behaviors In Everyday Settings) will revolutionize the ecological validity, cultural diversity, global practice, and transparency of developmental science. We will establish the first global video corpus of behaviors in 1000+ infants and mothers during one hour of natural activity. Each home visit will be accompanied by 3D, manipulable renderings of the spaces, materials, and cultural artifacts of everyday settings, indoors and out. All videos and metadata will be openly shared with researchers from 740+ institutions across the globe.
This volume includes exemplar visits from global sites to demonstrate the full protocol of Global BABIES for complete transparency. We also offer shorter excerpts of aspects of the protocol for demonstration and training.
